basic_profile.bio: Avid explorer of the obscure and bizarre corners of the internet, hailing from a small town in the Midwest. Currently working as a night-shift security guard, which gives me plenty of time to surf Reddit during the off-hours. Passionate about medieval lore and quirky internet subcultures. Not big on social media, but Reddit is my primary go-to for online interaction. Single, but open to meeting like-minded individuals. Typically online during late nights to early mornings due to my work schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in medieval history and internet culture, fueled by late-night Wikipedia rabbit holes and obscure forums. My interest in niche internet communities is a result of exploring various online platforms during quiet work hours.
